rationale: DEV-12..DEV-15 extend the existing fail-closed CFA3 development governance with a mandatory FA3/CFA3 work-session prenotice and status protocol. Long or multi-operation tasks require notice before the first substantive operation, each newly starting long phase requires fresh prenotice, blockers/unexpected GitHub state/security-sensitive operations require a separate prior notice, and long GitHub sequences require concise phase-boundary status updates. The protocol is a development-discipline preflight only: it creates no provider, runner, daemon, scheduler, hardware path, host lease, driver, service, credential flow, execution authority, or physical Current Host PASS. Existing UAF, Security Governance, HRB, Model Router and Evidence authorities remain unchanged.
